text: 你俯视着异界恐怖——它像是从噩梦维度中因宇宙意外而喷涌出来的怪物。不知为何，你仍保持理智，得以观察它。
面对它的那半边身体感到寒冷，仿佛这生物正在吸走周围环境的热能。也许是为了进食？一只邪恶的眼睛位于它身体中央，周围辐射出海星般的腿。它看起来像一组直立的辐条，却没有轮子。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 166
text: You gaze down upon alien horror—a monster belched by cosmic accident from a dimension of nightmare. Somehow your sanity holds and you are able to study it.

The side of your body that faces it feels cold, as if the creature drains heat energy from its environment. Perhaps for nourishment? Starfish-like legs radiate from one malignant eye at the center of its body. It looks something like an upright set of spokes with no wheel.
